items.title: Remedy Robotics Finalizes $62M Series B Funding
items.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, CA, Remedy Robotics, a leading healthcare and physical AI company developing robotic systems for cardiovascular care and endovascular intervention, announced it has raised $62 million in Series B funding.
